question: Is the D(z)/2 diameter floor a general property of accepted fibre certificates, or an artefact of the A_t/B_t construction?

why_this_is_not_already_answered.already_frozen: C-C3 gives 5t-term instances A_t,B_t sharing ordered weights and the complete labeled pair-gain matrix with value gap 2t-1. C2-C4 gives the real pair-only minimax additive radius (2t-1)/2 for deterministic estimators on that input.
why_this_is_not_already_answered.gap: Those are statements about one construction. The #1615 hypothesis is general: for ANY representation fibre F_z with target diameter D(z), any certificate accepted on the whole fibre incurs worst-case error at least D(z)/2, any accepted interval of radius < D(z)/2 misses a member, and a balanced two-point distribution on a diameter-attaining pair forces conditional miscoverage at least 1/2.
why_this_is_not_already_answered.consequence_if_general: The R24 terminal C_R24_ARM_CONDITIONAL_CERTIFICATE_INVALID stops being a tuning failure and becomes a structural impossibility, and 'raw coverage cannot substitute for conditional risk control' acquires a mechanism.

what_this_protocol_does_NOT_do: It does not re-derive or verify C-C3 or C2-C4. No executable A_t/B_t constructor exists in this repository; the family is a paper-level construction resting on B.3(c), a cross-gadget separability lemma the manuscript does not state.
Reimplementing A_t/B_t here and then 'verifying' it would test the reimplementation, not the frozen claim. A_t/B_t is therefore CITED as the instance that makes the floor unbounded, never re-proved.
It does not touch any frozen claim, terminal, or ledger entry.

method.proof: Elementary and stated in full in THEORY.md. The load-bearing step is that a certificate accepted on the whole fibre is a function of z alone, so it cannot separate two members of F_z.
method.machine_check: Exhaustive enumeration over a finite family of fibre configurations. For each configuration compute D(z) and search ALL admissible deterministic certificates for one achieving worst-case absolute error strictly below D(z)/2 - tol. The search is for a COUNTEREXAMPLE; finding none over an exhaustive family is the evidence.
method.enumeration_family: fibres of size k in 2..5 with target values drawn from a frozen finite grid; all configurations enumerated, none sampled

controls.statement: A certificate permitted to see the member index, not only z, MUST achieve worst-case error 0 and therefore beat the floor whenever D(z) > 0. If this control does not fire, the search cannot detect a floor violation and the instrument is invalid.

On a fibre whose members all share one target value, D(z)=0 and the floor is vacuous. The checker must report NO violation here. A checker that alarms on the degenerate case cries wolf and is invalid.

For the point-certificate case the achieved optimum must equal exactly D(z)/2, attained at the midpoint of a diameter-attaining pair. A search returning an optimum above D(z)/2 has not searched the admissible set.

conditions: no configuration admits a certificate below D(z)/2 - tol
terminals.licenses: A bounded statement that the D(z)/2 floor is general for accepted fibre certificates on this enumerated family, with A_t/B_t cited as the instance making it unbounded.
does_not_license: any claim about achievable risk on real data
revival of any retracted ORION-02 claim

conditions: some configuration admits an accepted certificate with worst-case error < D(z)/2 - tol
terminals.reading: The general theorem is false as stated, or the fibre is mis-identified. This is the registered falsifier named in THEORY.md 3.1.

conditions: a balanced two-point distribution on a diameter-attaining pair yields conditional miscoverage < 1/2 for an accepted interval of radius < D(z)/2
C1 does not fire, or C3 fails
terminals.reading: The search cannot detect violations. No claim is read either way.

conditions: the enumeration could not be completed

falsifiability_self_check.note: T2 is a real possibility only if the theorem is wrong; the design's value is that an exhaustive search either finds the counterexample or establishes there is none on this family.

stop_rule: Outcomes are read once. If T2 or T3 is reached, the general hypothesis is recorded as refuted and the lane stops; the frozen C-C3/C2-C4 results are unaffected either way.
